result:
I added a guard to all three partials, so a missing `search` property is treated as an empty string. The `.replace` call no longer throws when `link` isn't an anchor or is an empty jQuery object. I haven't run the simulation screens in a browser or run any tests.

The changed line is now `var p = (link.prop("search") || "").replace(/^\?/, "");` in:
- `notifications/_params_form.html.erb:79`
- `queries/_params_form.html.erb:70`
- `assertions/_params_form.html.erb:62`

I didn't verify the selector that builds `link`. In each partial it comes from the `link-target` data attribute (`#as_<resources>-simulate-<id>-link`, or `-execute-` for queries). The partials only read it inside a change handler, so I didn't check whether the "Uncaught TypeError" fires on page load. If that id doesn't match an anchor on the simulate pages, the guard stops the error but the query string won't be picked up from the link.
